description: This file defines the LoggerXmlLayout class for PHP, which formats logging events into XML conforming to the log4php.dtd. It configures how logs are serialized into XML, including options for location info and namespace handling.

classes.name: LoggerXmlLayout
classes.description: A layout class for formatting log events as XML, extending LoggerLayout with options for including location info and namespace configuration.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Initializes namespace settings based on the log4jNamespace flag.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the XML header for the log event set, including namespace declarations.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log event into an XML string according to the layout's configuration.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns the closing tag for the event set XML.

methods.name: getLocationInfo
methods.description: Returns whether location info is included in the log output.

methods.name: getLog4jNamespace
methods.description: Returns whether the log4j namespace is used.

methods.name: ignoresThrowable
methods.description: Indicates that the layout does not ignore exceptions; it prints them.

methods.name: setLocationInfo
methods.description: Sets whether location info should be included in logs.

methods.name: setLog4jNamespace
methods.description: Sets whether to use the log4j namespace.
